headline: A 2014 law officially changes the name of a Bainbridge Island, Washington memorial to the Bainbridge Island Japanese American Exclusion Memorial.
what_it_does: The law makes a technical correction to an earlier 2008 law so that it uses the memorial's new name. It renames the Bainbridge Island Japanese American Memorial as the Bainbridge Island Japanese American Exclusion Memorial. The official summary describes only this name change.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on September 26, 2014.
